## prompt-draft-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting
`inputs/auto-bill-02/sub-prompts/prompt-5-draft-bill.md` to the Physical AI
oncology trial protocol. Runs in stage `trial-protocol/draft-protocol/`.*

Write the **draft (scaffold)** of the Phase 1 protocol LaTeX into
`trial-protocol/draft-protocol/`, building from the **paper template**
(`trial-protocol/template`, recolored to Corporate Blue `#00417A`) and adapting
the **NIH-FDA IND/IDE Protocol Template** (`trial-protocol/nih-protocol`, which
supersedes the paper-template format where they differ). The draft is a
scaffold: it lays out the complete protocol architecture and, for every content
slot, provides bracketed **[DRAFTING INSTRUCTIONS]** that name the exact
`trial-protocol` files and directories the full stage must process (for example
`[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION: render mermaid/fig-07 vascular safety-zone gate as a
TikZ mermaidfig; pull the 1.0/3.0/5.0 mm thresholds from
inputs/2030-pdac-1min-final-paper/sections/methods.tex]`), rather than the
finished prose.

**Addressed sections (each a separate `sections/*.tex` file, one per NIH
template section, Rule 6).** Statement of Compliance; Protocol Summary
(Synopsis, Schema, Schedule of Activities); Introduction (Study Rationale,
Background, Risk/Benefit Assessment); Objectives and Endpoints; Study Design;
Study Population; Study Intervention; Intervention and Participant
Discontinuation/Withdrawal; Study Assessments and Procedures; Statistical
Considerations; Regulatory, Ethical, and Oversight Considerations; Additional
Considerations, Abbreviations, and Amendment History; References and Back
Matter. Every section must appear in a clickable, page-filling table of
contents. Include the protocol back matter (authorship, ORCID, DOI, data
availability, disclosures) adapted from the paper template.

**Required content carried into the scaffold.** The combined IND/IDE Phase 1 /
early-feasibility framing; the three counterfactual scenarios where withholding
the LLM + robot + medicine combination shortens PFS and OS; the eight Physical
AI concerns and mitigations; the senior-author white-space and table rules; and
bracketed pointers to all 20+ Stage 1 figures so the full stage renders each as
a TikZ `mermaidfig`. Provide a brief description of each main document
(`inputs/2030-pdac-1min-final-paper`, `inputs/21cfr312_adapt`,
`inputs/auto-bill-02`) where cited, and use author works only where directly
necessary.

**Media (Rule 3).** No PNG or JPG. Permitted media are full-width
white-background tables, centered monospace ASCII figures, and the gray-scale /
blue-accent Mermaid diagrams reproduced in LaTeX as TikZ `mermaidfig`
environments. White background throughout.

**Files and commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit each for `main.tex`,
`protostyle.sty`, `references.bib`, and `README.md`; one commit per
`sections/*.tex` file (each corresponds to an `\input` in `main.tex`). Also file
`prompt-draft-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim under a
`## prompt-draft-protocol` heading) and `output-draft-protocol.md` (narrative
output). Push every commit in real time (10+ commits). The second-to-last
commit fixes all errors across all files. The last commit writes the directory
README (badges, repository structure, colored Mermaid, figure and table
inventory naming source files) and `draft-protocol-LaTeX.zip` (an Overleaf
bundle that compiles with pdfLaTeX).

**Formatting (centralize in `protostyle.sty`).** White background; RaggedRight
body with even interword spacing and no right-margin overflow; maximal widow and
orphan penalties so no single line is stranded and no one- or two-word last line
is left behind; correct "SS" into "§"; single hyphens only (no en, em, double,
or triple dashes); every table column uses `>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{<width>}`
at `\textwidth`; senior-author `\clearpage`, `\vspace`, and `\hspace` page
balancing; the `#00417A` accent. Date the cover June 20, 2026; DOI
`10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx`; version v4.0.0. Do not stall, ask questions, or go
into plan mode. The LaTeX must compile in Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
